title: Onboard Handoff Spotlight Brief - 2029-11-01
content:
Pulse brief for the SE + ProServices customer handoff cadence. Purpose: 10–15 minute sync artifact for handoff clarity, highlight 3 customers at risk or at milestone, and capture decisions + owners. Use this as the single-thread summary for CSMs, PMs, and SRE touchpoints until formal runbook is published.

Attendees: Maya Chen (owner), Diego Alvarez (field eng), Priya Nair (proservices PM), Samir Gupta (integration), Leah O'Connor (CSM), with ad-hoc input from infra on call.

TL;DR (top 3):
- Veridian Health: Onboarding in pivot week; KV cache mismatch causing 95th pct latency spikes on long-context flows. Hotfix plan agreed; high-priority.
- Tidewater Analytics: Feature-complete; needs dedicated capacity sizing sign-off and can move to Dedicated in 2 weeks pending quota approval.
- Bluecove Retail: Data ingestion schema mismatch; requires mapping and a small transform layer — low infra risk but blocking staging validation.

Color health summary (green/amber/red):
- Veridian Health: RED — performance regressions observed after model variant upgrade (gptx-compat-3q).
- Tidewater Analytics: AMBER — functional ready, pending procurement and security sign-off.
- Bluecove Retail: AMBER-GREEN — integration work remains but risks are non-blocking provided mapping is delivered by Bluecove.

Detailed notes by customer:

1) Veridian Health (hospital client, HIPAA scope)
- Current sprint status: pivoted to a middleware hotfix after KV cache invalidations surfaced in end-to-end tests (seen 2029-10-30 smoke run).
- Symptom: intermittent 95th percentile latency spikes ~ 700–900ms on multi-turn summarization flows (>3k tokens). Root cause initial hypothesis: cache key namespace collision when request metadata contains non-normalized IDs.
- Immediate mitigation (agreed): deploy transient prefixing in serving runtime to isolate Veridian namespace (Samir to prod patch). Rollback plan in place.
- Long-term: add normalized request-id canonicalization and unit tests in runtime (owner: Diego).
- Blocking? YES for SLA-sensitive workflows; customer flagged in-app.
- Action items:
  - Samir: push prod prefix patch v0.1, monitor 95/99 latency, ETA 2029-11-02 EOD (JIRA:SE-3421).
  - Maya: prepare customer-facing note to Leah for Veridian CSM communication, ETA 2029-11-02 10:00 PT.
  - Diego: design canonicalization tests, RFC due 2029-11-06.
- Risks: temporary prefixing could expose edge cases for KV cache eviction — add read-through metrics.

2) Tidewater Analytics (SaaS analytics firm)
- Current sprint status: onboarding feature-complete; on staging with test harness. Running throughput characterization.
- Key ask: Dedicated capacity sizing (expected sustained tokens/sec 2.5k, burst 8k). Need sign-off from capacity planning + finance for monthly commit.
- Security: pending final pen-test confirmation for VPC-peering (security team asked for one additional network ACL test).
- Action items:
  - Priya: consolidate capacity numbers and run cost model in Optimize tool, deliver recommendation 2029-11-05.
  - Leah + Customer: finalize procurement timeline; aim to flip to Dedicated by 2029-11-15.
  - Infra: schedule VPC ACL test window with Tidewater (infra owner to confirm slot by 2029-11-03).
- Notes: if Dedicated rollout delayed, provide a temporary hosted fallback with rate-limited routing and cached prefixes to meet SLOs.

3) Bluecove Retail (mid-market, high catalog churn)
- Current sprint status: ETL pipeline ingestion tests failing schema validations on staging; errors occur in product_attributes JSON blobs.
- Root cause: inconsistent capitalization and nested attribute keys from upstream feed.
- Proposed fix: lightweight transform lambda to normalize keys and strip unexpected fields before ingestion. Low risk.
- Action items:
  - Samir: prototype transform lambda and integration test harness, ETA 2029-11-04.
  - Bluecove engineering: deliver canonical schema sample by 2029-11-03.
  - Maya: validate staging run once sample provided and report back 2029-11-05.

Cross-customer notes (operational):
- Observability: request from SEs to add a "per-customer prefix hit/miss" dashboard tile in Console. Diego to propose panel by 2029-11-06.
- Rollout policy: consider a temporary model-variant pin for Veridian flows while we stabilize. Policy owner: Product Console (cc: Priya).
- KB/checklist: create a short handoff checklist for HIPAA customers that includes KV namespace checks and test prompts. Owner: Maya, draft 2029-11-07.

Open questions / parking lot:
- Do we want automatic namespace isolation for all V1 customers, or opt-in? (Product decision required).
- If prefixing becomes common, do we need a KV namespace quota module in Console? (Infra + Product).
- Should we formalize a rapid-hotfix protocol for model-variant upgrades? (SRE + Runtime).

Decisions made on call:
- Apply transient KV prefixing for Veridian immediately and monitor; if latencies reduce to baseline within 24h, schedule canonicalization in next sprint.
- Tidewater Dedicated size will be recommended by Priya but final commit requires finance sign-off — fallback plan confirmed.

Action item tracker (summary):
- SE-3421: Samir — prod prefix patch v0.1 — due 2029-11-02 (RED).
- PRO-889: Priya — capacity recommendation doc + cost model — due 2029-11-05 (AMBER).
- Maya — Veridian customer note and handoff for CSM — due 2029-11-02 10:00 PT (GREEN).
- Samir — Bluecove transform prototype — due 2029-11-04 (AMBER-GREEN).
- Diego — observability panel proposal — due 2029-11-06 (AMBER).

Notes to self / non-finalized ideas (rough):
- Could use a short-lived feature-flag to route Veridian to non-quantized exec path while debugging to separate quantization-related regressions. Costy but useful for triage.
- Add a seeding test dataset for each customer that includes token-length edge cases. Useful for verifying batching & KV behavior.

Next sync: quick pulse call next Friday (2029-11-08) 9:00 PT. If Veridian remains red, escalate to runtime on-call with SRE lead.

Attachments / references (attached in slack thread): request logs, flamegraphs from 2029-10-30 smoke run, and staging validation CSVs.

End of brief.
